latest_release.name: v3.0.6
latest_release.body:
## What's Changed
* fix(answer-utils): stop text logic matching unanswered fields by @RaphaelFakhri in https://github.com/heyform/heyform/pull/352
* fix(answer-utils): accept negative numbers when no min is set by @y9ndra in https://github.com/heyform/heyform/pull/354
* fix(webapp): scroll multi-select dropdown options instead of overflowing by @RafaelJaime in https://github.com/heyform/heyform/pull/360
* feat: reply-to, respondent subject and owner skip notification options by @RafaelJaime in https://github.com/heyform/heyform/pull/361
* feat(integrations): page apps, starting with Privatus Analytics by @ja-andrews in https://github.com/heyform/heyform/pull/362
* fix(server): clear the form analytics cache on each visit and submission by @iMuFeng in https://github.com/heyform/heyform/pull/366
* fix(answer-utils): let respondents submit forms with a file attached by @gruffvaughan in https://github.com/heyform/heyform/pull/371
* fix(form-renderer): make progress reflect the respondent's route by @gruffvaughan in https://github.com/heyform/heyform/pull/373
* fix(webapp): use the themed select for "Next question" in logic by @yuyongyan29-dev in https://github.com/heyform/heyform/pull/380
* refactor: switch the Nest builder to SWC for faster builds by @iMuFeng in https://github.com/heyform/heyform/pull/383
* fix(upload): send signatures as named files instead of anonymous blobs by @xwxfox in https://github.com/heyform/heyform/pull/382

## New Contributors
* @RaphaelFakhri made their first contribution in https://github.com/heyform/heyform/pull/352
* @y9ndra made their first contribution in https://github.com/heyform/heyform/pull/354
* @ja-andrews made their first contribution in https://github.com/heyform/heyform/pull/362
* @yuyongyan29-dev made their first contribution in https://github.com/heyform/heyform/pull/380
* @xwxfox made their first contribution in https://github.com/heyform/heyform/pull/382

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/heyform/heyform/compare/v3.0.5...v3.0.6

detail.readme:
Open-source form builder, built for small business success

Website | Documentation | Blog

## Features HeyForm simplifies the creation of conversational forms, making it accessible for anyone to gather information or feedback through engaging surveys, quizzes, and polls. We are committed to enhancing HeyForm with regular updates, including bug fixes, new features, and performance improvements. ### Build Forms with Ease - **Versatile Inputs**: From basic text, email, and phone number fields to advanced options like picture choices, date pickers, and file uploads, HeyForm supports a wide array of input types. - **Smart Logic**: Conditional logic and URL redirections for dynamic, adaptable forms. - **Powerful Integrations**: Connect with webhooks, analytics, marketing platforms, and tools like Zapier and Make.com. ### Customize to Your Brand - **Visual Themes**: Tailor the look and feel of your forms to match your brand identity with customizable fonts, colors, backgrounds, and more. - **Advanced Theming**: Gain greater control with extensive customization options, including custom CSS for deeper personalization. ### Analyze and Act on Data - **Insightful Analytics**: Gain insights with detailed analytics, including drop-off rates and completion rates. - **Data Export**: Easily export your form results to CSV for further analysis or integration into your systems. ## Getting started with HeyForm The simplest and most efficient way to dive into HeyForm is through [our official hosted service](https://my.heyform.net). When you choose this cloud version, you're getting the advantage of high reliability, automatic backups, robust security, and hassle-free maintenance—all carefully managed by us, the passionate duo behind HeyForm. Choosing our hosted version not only saves a significant amount of time and resources but also supports HeyForm's development and the open-source community. Get a great service while backing innovation. 💙 ## Structure ``` . └── packages ├── answer-utils (form submission utils for server and webapp) ├── embed (form embed javascript library) ├── form-renderer (form rendering library) ├── shared-types-enums (shared types/enums for server and webapp) ├── utils (common utils for server and webapp) ├── server (node server) └── webapp (react webapp) ``` ## Self-hosting Interested in self-hosting HeyForm on your server? Take a look at the [self-hosting installation instructions](https://docs.heyform.net/open-source/self-hosting). To connect a self-hosted identity provider such as Authelia, Authentik, or Keycloak, see the [generic OpenID Connect setup guide](https://docs.heyform.net/open-source/configuration/oidc). ### One Click Deployment ## Local development Follow the [local installation instructions](https://docs.heyform.net/open-source/local-development) to run the project locally. ## How to Contribute You are awesome, let's build great software together. Head over to the [contribute docs](https://docs.heyform.net/open-source/contribute) to get started. 💪 ## Support & Community You'll find a lot of resources to help you get started with HeyForm in the [help center](https://docs.heyform.net). However, if you can't find what you're looking for there, don't hesitate to reach out to us: - Have a question? Join the [Discord server](https://discord.gg/sgT4v4GSTe) and get instant help. - Found a bug? [Create an issue](https://github.com/heyform/heyform/issues/new/choose) ## License HeyForm is open-source under the GNU Affero General Public License v3.0 (AGPL-3.0), you will find more information about the license and how to comply with it [here](https://docs.heyform.net/open-source/license).
